pillars.name: Social
pillars.story: Historical poverty reduction sits alongside recent food insecurity and a substantial youth employment gap.

cards.name: Poverty Headcount Ratio
cards.subtitle: A historical baseline for material deprivation; this survey does not measure poverty today.
cards.source: CSO / World Bank, Living Conditions in Grenada

cards.name: Moderate-to-Severe Food Insecurity Rate
cards.subtitle: Food insecurity remains a distinct concern alongside the older poverty baseline.

cards.name: Unemployment Rate and Youth Unemployment Rate
cards.subtitle: Youth unemployment is more than twice the overall rate in the same quarter.

pillars.name: Economic
pillars.story: Economic growth and tourism earnings sit alongside price pressures, public debt and a large goods trade deficit.

cards.name: Real GDP Growth Rate
cards.subtitle: Measures expansion of the economy, rather than how growth is distributed among households.

cards.name: Inflation Rate
cards.subtitle: Low inflation means slower price increases; it does not mean prices returned to earlier levels.

cards.name: Total Public Debt-to-GDP Ratio
cards.subtitle: Public debt affects the room available to fund development and respond to shocks.

cards.name: Merchandise Trade Balance
cards.subtitle: Goods imports far exceed goods exports; this measure excludes services earnings.

cards.name: Visitor Expenditure
cards.subtitle: Visitor spending provides services earnings; it does not measure tourism’s full contribution to GDP.

pillars.name: Environmental
pillars.story: A major hurricane shock and diesel-dominated electricity make disaster resilience and energy transition central development concerns.

cards.name: Estimated Direct Economic Damage from Hurricane Beryl
cards.subtitle: Damage equivalent to 16.5% of 2023 GDP shows the scale of a single hurricane shock.
cards.source: World Bank / GFDRR, Hurricane Beryl GRADE

cards.name: Net Electricity Generation by Source
cards.subtitle: Diesel dominates electricity generation, linking energy transition with resilience and fuel exposure.
cards.secondary: Source values converted from kWh to GWh; these describe the Grenlec system.

counting_rule: Every distinct displayed statistical value counts, including contextual and secondary values. Dates, units and source metadata are excluded. Repeated labels of the same value do not add a fact.
